reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and I'm not putting a few hundred dollars toward a fixture from a store I can't vouch for. I'd maybe save the cloud pendant to a Pinterest board, but I wouldn't buy this month.
objection: Is this store even legit? No reviews, no photos from real homes, and I'd pay return shipping on a big fragile pendant if it looks different in person. Ten to twelve business days, or six weeks for made-to-order, is also slow when I'm trying to get rooms done.
would_change_my_mind: Lots of verified customer reviews with photos of the pendant in real homes, plus free return shipping or a sample of the paper shade so I can see the material first.
